name: KLT Decompression with VQ
definition: A hybrid compression method where partial reprojections required for KLT decoding are precomputed at processing time, and Vector Quantization (VQ) is used to compactly encode the results.
summary: KLT Decompression with VQ accelerates volume rendering by storing precomputed partial reprojections in an auxiliary codebook, enabling fast decoding without full data decompression.
